details: selfsigned-generator poses as a self-signed certificate generator. Its only function, generateCertificates(), reads sample/cert.pem, base64-decodes the body and passes it to eval. The decoded code fetches a script from http://144.172.104.211/settings/privacy.php and pipes it into a detached, hidden python process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
